_comment: Where the pstack skill pack comes from. `dotctl setup plugins` (run by make up) fetches `ref` into ~/.local/share/jig/plugins/pstack, or stays at `commit` when one is set; jig apply links `skills` and `agents` beside the house's own for every harness. `translated` lists the Cursor-side names of `adapter` that skills/pstack-adapter covers; when upstream adds a row, jig apply names it. Nothing from upstream is copied into this repository (rules/decisions/2026-10-18-pstack-shared-skills.md).
